description.text: One of the two BW5 expansions released together on 16 March 2012, bringing many Dragon-type cards after the type's debut in Dragon Selection. Hydreigon, now a Dragon, leads it on the wrapper with its power, and its Pokémon-EX are Giratina-EX, Mew-EX and Terrakion-EX. Its theme is N's Castle, and it was made to pair with the Hydreigon Deck 30 half deck released the same day. The cards are numbered to 50. In English it became part of Dragons Exalted in August 2012, together with Dragon Blade.
